title: Status route has no regression coverage
reasoning: The route defines a user-facing polling contract with authentication, UUID lookup, 404 behavior, nested progress serialization, and ETA calculation, but the feature lists no tests and a repository search found no tests for get_digest_status or this status route. A future change could break the response shape or missing-digest behavior without failing CI.
recommendation: Add focused FastAPI client tests for GET /{digest_id}/status covering a found digest, an unknown digest returning 404, and the processing ETA/progress fields. Include the API key dependency path if existing route tests exercise authenticated requests that way.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and no matching test references to get_digest_status or /{digest_id}/status were found under tests/app during inspection.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a Digest fixture with status='processing', total_feeds, feeds_fetched, total_articles, and articles_enriched set; call GET /digests/{id}/status with valid auth; assert 200 plus the exact nested progress fields and eta_seconds. Then call the route with a random UUID and assert 404 with detail 'Digest not found'.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level tests only; no production code change is required unless tests expose a contract mismatch.
